title: SoLonely's latest single, "It won't be fine," is a powerful and deeply personal track
htmlContent:
SoLonely's latest single, "It won't be fine," is a powerful and deeply personal track that shines a light on mental health struggles. The Swedish artist has been open about his own experiences with depression, and this song reflects that journey.

With a haunting melody and raw lyrics, "It won't be fine" is a message of hope for those struggling with their mental health. SoLonely's emotive vocals capture the pain and despair of feeling alone, while the chorus offers a glimmer of optimism: "It won't be fine, but it will be alright."
This song speaks to the heart and soul of anyone who has ever battled with mental health issues.

SoLonely's ability to capture these complex emotions through his music is a testament to his talent as an artist. "It won't be fine" is a powerful reminder that, no matter how difficult things may seem, there is always hope for a brighter tomorrow.
